code:
import socketserver, datetime

class Handler(socketserver.DatagramRequestHandler):
    def handle(self):
        data = self.rfile.read().decode(errors='replace').rstrip()
        ts = datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        line = f"{ts} {self.client_address[0]} {data}\n"
        with open("{{output_file}}", "a") as f: f.write(line)
        print(line, end='')

with socketserver.UDPServer(("0.0.0.0", {{bind_port}}), Handler) as s:
    print(f"syslog listening on udp/{{{{bind_port}}}}")
    s.serve_forever()
